question: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports (MYAS) has sanctioned a total of ________ sportspersons across 17 sporting disciplines for participation in the upcoming Asian Para Games.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1 (303)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports (MYAS) has sanctioned a total of **303 sportspersons** across 17 sporting disciplines for the upcoming Asian Para Games.
 
• The Asian Para Games is scheduled to be held in **Hangzhou, China**, from **October 22 to October 28, 2023**.
 
• This is the **largest-ever contingent** fielded by India for the Asian Para Games.
 
• The sanctioned sportspersons include **120 female athletes**, highlighting India's push toward inclusivity and gender representation in sports.
 
• The government has also ensured full financial support for training, participation, and other logistical arrangements for the contingent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Asian Para Games:**

 
 
• The Asian Para Games is a multi-sport event held every four years for athletes with physical disabilities.
 
• It is organized by the **Asian Paralympic Committee** and is parallel to the Asian Games.
 
• India has been actively participating since its inception in **2010**.
 
 
 
• **Paralympic Sports:**
 
 
• Paralympic sports are specifically designed for athletes with a range of physical disabilities, including visual impairment, amputations, and cerebral palsy.
 
• They are governed by the **International Paralympic Committee (IPC)**.
 
 
 
• **Indian Achievements in Para Sports:**
 
 
• India has seen a remarkable rise in its performance in para sports over recent years, with notable achievements in athletics, badminton, and powerlifting.
 
• In the **Tokyo 2020 Paralympics**, India won a record **19 medals**, including 5 golds.
 
 
 
• **Government Initiatives:**
 
 
• The government has launched schemes such as the **Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)** to support elite para-athletes.
 
• Special training centers and funding programs have been introduced to promote para sports in India.
